top_signals.title: Trump says he'd meet with Putin and Xi, criticizes Zelenskyy
top_signals.summary: Tensions between Trump and Zelenskyy have steadily risen in recent weeks, while Russia, which invaded Ukraine, has received multiple breaks from the U.S.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
top_signals.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: JD Vance refrains from endorsing Israeli leader Netanyahu as Trump offers praise
top_signals.summary: Vice President JD Vance declined to follow Trump in endorsing Netanyahu, saying he’s “not getting involved in Israeli elections” a week before Israelis vote.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
top_signals.summary: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
